stages_examined: actual shared publisher delivery and inventory deduplication
delivery.result: All 36 eligible assignments survive in 46/46 delivered records. Within-bank fixed slot, position and operation-type probes are nonconstant. Donor labels alone can match multiple bank operations and are not a response key. Actual rendered position varies. Positive hard-weight selection has no bank filter; unconfigured or zero-hard-weight policies have the documented limits.

limitations: q-20392 lacks captured difficulty, key and solution; its unique completion remains replay-only.
Source canonical example has no original radio bank. Its reasoning supports the scope without an invented bank.
No live learner policy/history or future publication IDs supplied; no live selection probability claimed.
Non-source inventory generation metadata is absent; no exact generation replay of stored instances claimed.
Finite cue probes and purposeful winner coverage establish no demonstrated shortcut; they do not prove natural-frequency balance or exclude all possible strategies.
